name: PDF RAG (API) - Ingest
description: Upload a PDF: Mistral OCR reads it, Mistral embeds the chunks, Qdrant Cloud stores them with page numbers.
rationale: Separate from the chat flow so a question never re-runs OCR. The fixed search query proves the chunks were stored.
assumptions: Register langflow/mistral_ocr.py with `flowgen component import` first.
Replace the url with your Qdrant Cloud cluster URL, the same one in both flows.
Create Langflow global variables MISTRAL_API_KEY and QDRANT_API_KEY.
Left out on purpose: page stitching, section tree, section summaries, cross-references and the completeness audit; no stock node does these.
Left out on purpose: linking margin notes to the printed text they annotate; this flow does not request word positions.
